dialogues.speaker: Enteka
dialogues.text: Haha, looks like you are a cat lover, too.

dialogues.speaker: Enteka
dialogues.text: Here's a tip for you, my friend! Gata prefers Fowl to Fish.

dialogues.speaker: Enteka
dialogues.text: If Gata eats the Fowl you feed her, then she must be willing to be your friend!
